_doc: Commands that must go through devctl so sessions never fight over a device or kill each other's apps.

rules.message: Devices, emulators and heavy builds are shared between sessions through the devctl ledger. The devctl command is `{{DEVCTL}}` (see the devctl skill). Run `{{DEVCTL}} status` first, then `{{DEVCTL}} run <device> [flutter run args]`, `{{DEVCTL}} exec <device> -- <cmd>`, `{{DEVCTL}} build -- <cmd>` or `{{DEVCTL}} emu <avd>`. If another session owns the device, `{{DEVCTL}} wait <device> "purpose"`; when done, `{{DEVCTL}} release <device>`. Never kill other sessions' apps or emulators (pkill etc.).
